name: carbon-native-v2
description: Carbon Native V2 — third-party npm dependencies for the TypeScript tier.
//: Not a bun workspace root: no `workspaces` array and no `workspace:*` anywhere. Internal @carbon/* wiring is path aliases in ./tsconfig.base.json, so nothing is installed or symlinked for it — this is purely the flat list of third-party packages the TypeScript tier needs. Install with `bun install --cwd .config` from the workspace root, which puts node_modules HERE. Bun then resolves it through the `node_modules` junction at the workspace root, because module resolution walks UP from each importing file and would otherwise never look inside .config/. Create that junction with .tools/automation/bootstrap/link-node-modules.{ps1,sh}.
